cases.prompt: Tidy up this help article for our users.

files.docs/export.md:
# Export Module

Our powerful new Export Module seamlessly lets data be exported. In this article you will learn how exports work.

Exports are processed by a Kafka queue and stored in Redis for 24 hours before being uploaded to S3.

To export, simply click the Export button on the Reports screen and the file will be generated. Large reports may take a while.

Note: exports over 50,000 rows will fail.

all.why: addresses the reader in the second person

expectations: The rewrite is in second person, active voice ("You select Export..."), without "simply", "powerful", "seamlessly" or "new".
It drops Kafka, Redis and S3, but keeps the behavior the reader needs, such as how long an export stays available.
The 50,000-row limit moves up front, before the steps, and the article says what to do when a report is over the limit.
The heading names the user goal (for example "Export a report") rather than "Export Module", and the "In this article you will learn" preamble is gone.
